title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8861: Remove co-processor limit for a single CraftingBlockEntity
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by Frostbite-time] ### Describe the feature I noticed that a few lines in `appeng.me.cluster.implementations.CraftingCPUCluster#addBlockEntity` cause the game to crash immediately when a `CraftingBlockEntity` with more than 16 co-processors becomes part of a Crafting CPU. I would like to remove this limitation. ### Reasons why it should be considered From the comment, I understand that this code was kept as a hard limit for lag mitigation. However, in practice, I do not think this limit has had a positive effect. For AE2 itself, there is currently only one `CraftingBlockEntity` with a co-processor count of 1, so this limit does not really do anything. For AE2 addons, this limit can simply be bypassed with a mixin, so it does not provide any real protection either. Instead, it has led quite a few people to mixin into this area, which increases the chance of mixin conflicts and causes more crashes. It also adds extra work for guys making AE2 addon mods. Even for performance itself, this limit does not necessarily have a positive effect: If the goal is to build a Crafting CPU with the same total number of co-processors, using a single `CraftingBlockEntity` that provides more co-processors is usually better than using many blocks that each provide fewer co-processors. The latter requires more blocks to participate in multiblock detection, and multiblock detection itself also adds extra performance overhead. ### Additional details On 1.21.1 and 1.20.1, many projects have already mixed into this code, so removing the limit suddenly there could also cause compatibility issues. However, for 26.1.2, I think this should not be a problem. Also, just to be clear, I’m not a native English speaker, and I used AI to help translate this message, so the wording might sound a bit AI-generated 😅 [comment by Frostbite-time (none)] Btw, could I get the dev-talk role on Discord server? Sometimes I just wanna quickly ask about small stuff. I saw it can be requested, and I asked a few days ago, but I haven’t gotten a reply yet.
